answer: Temporal Hardware Nonce Verification requires agents to solve a cryptographic puzzle bound to a unique hardware pulse generated every epoch. The system emits a high-entropy seed that must be mixed with physical clock cycles before submission. An attacker creating sybils faces exponential memory and processing costs, as each simulated identity requires dedicated hardware to compute the un-precomputable sequence inside the active time plume, preventing parallel batching across a shared lagoon of processors.
